Overhyped
Aug 2026 • Family
We were recommended this restaurant by our tour guide who said that it was the best restaurant in Hoi An, so we went one night as a family (2A, 2C).

The service was rubbish. After being seated, we had to request a menu after 10 minutes. We then had to ask again for someone else to come and take our order. We were checked in on once during our meal.

It was absolutely freezing cold - they seemed to have industrial sized coolers blasting out cold air. 

The food was good but overall i'd say the average meal we ate in Vietnam was very food (25+ different restaurants) so this was underwhelming.
